Get in Touch here!

Crosspoint Women’s Bible studies have been such a place of uplifting spiritual growth for me personally. The biblical and spiritual insights I’ve learned through the Bible study teachings and hearing from the experiences of other women of so many different age groups have truly been  invaluable. In addition to that, the sense of community and belonging gained through connecting with other women in our church body has been an ongoing vital source of encouragement. I’ve also come to recognize my own value more in showing up with others in community.  
- Kelly Davis
